paragraphs: Chapter 1780 Old Monsters From the Past Age! ll
The journey would be long as there were multiple stops to make.

The Pure Blooded Domains of the 5 Cardinal Royal Bloodlines stretched out with the Main Reality at the center, where one would progressively find more and more clusters of Realities as well as Grotto Sanctums the closer they were to the Main Reality.

This would also be accompanied by increasingly powerful forces, especially in the Main Reality where the past Bloodline Rulers of the Pure-Blooded Cardinal Royal Bloodlines took positions as Representatives of their Bloodlines in the Primordial Alliance!
In the past Era, there was the Olden Alliance that contained Representatives of Ancient Bloodlines among many others.

In this new Age and Era- there was the established Primordial Alliance that held the true power of the Primordials, with the past Bloodline Masters of Primordial Bloodlines being the Representatives who enjoyed great status in the Main Reality!
These beings ascended their duties as mere Bloodline Masters when they became LEGENDS, their pathway smoothly going forward to give them positions as Representatives.
They instituted the laws and way of life from the Main Reality that all Bloodlines in the Infinite Realities had to follow!

With the Main Reality at the center and the Domains of the 5 Pure-Blooded Cardinal Royal Bloodlines stretching out all around, what followed thereafter was the domains of Cardinal Royal Bloodlines like the Royal Cosmic Wolves and then the domain of beings who were graced with the Primordial Bloodline like the Celestial Vines.
Past these Realities...one came across Unexplored lands and Realities that over the countless years- the Primordials had continued expanding their reach into!

The Purple Endeavor that Brightborn currently led wasn't going towards the Main Reality where the core power of Primordials was concentrated, and it was actually making its way towards the opposite direction where unexplored Realities stood.
The purpose of this were the so called 'Guests' that Brightborn mentioned.
Aboard the Purple Endeavor that was shooting across the veils of space.

Noah's figure was standing beside Beatrix as he watched a calm and unfettered visage of Adjudicator Katelyn who was currently replying to Genevieve's questions on the ridiculous change of going from a solidified crown to one that had the ecriture <SACRALIZED> rotating around it in what seemed like just a day!
'Did she break her Limits in an Aspect and forge multiple TABOO Edicts? In the period of a day?'
Noah had a level of skepticism as he had yet to meet someone who could perform terrifying feats in a short period of time like him!
<Wow, this girl is something else.>
WAA!
At this time, Lavalliere's voice echoed out as it actually held a hint of amazement when talking about Katelyn.

It was known in the Pure-Blooded Domains of the Royal Humans that Adjudicator Katelyn was a terrifying figure who held a Mythical Natural Born Physique that even LEGENDS sought after, so Noah had naturally thought of her when Lavalliere had begun mentioning Dual Cultivation!

Katelyn had also seen something with him as she helped him when obtaining the Refinement Techniques in the Bloodline Treasury, giving him a warning also if he ever sought to harm her Bloodline and those around her.
'What do you think, is she a good candidate?' Noah spoke freely with Lavalliere as her reply caused his eyes to shine with splendor.

<Well, yes and no. She is like a hot potato...I don't know whether you'll be able to handle the consequences if you do anything to her. And that's if she'll even show interest towards you...Hmm, hey-do you think you can easily make her fall for you? She's not like all the girls around you who need someone to save them, where even you might not be able to suppress her unless you go all out.>
HUUUM!
Lavalliere's words were biting and ruthless as Noah stroked his chin while replying lightly.

'I'm young, handsome, with a decent personality and a great Destiny. More than likely I'll also take the seat of the True Emperor in the future...and I've already got a cute Son and a few other women around me...I'm a catch, right?'
Noah nodded as he thought about himself, Lavalliere leaving him to his thoughts for a few seconds as he continued.
'And why is she a hot potato?'

<Her Lineage is unique even in the Mirror Dimension, tracing back to...- ah, look at me incurring karma and speaking without any Uses. Hey big guy, the chains around me are getting tighter if I blurt out information with no cost being paid. Just know that chasing her will be somewhat difficult.>

Lavalliere seemed fed up of speaking as she went quiet, Noah's eyes flashing with a Tyrannical light of confidence as he nodded while gazing at the speaking figures of Katelyn and Genevieve! Coincidentally, the glazed pupils of this existence turned over to his direction as she locked onto his eyes...her gaze even rising to lock onto the empty spot above his head where his crown should be but was hidden away by LETHE!

The glazed mirror eyes of this unique existence seemed to see and reflect all things that others couldn't as she seemingly raised her brows to Noah while she continued speaking to Genevieve with a light smile.
HUUUM!
Around this time, the Purple Endeavor slowed down as the surging spatial lights cleared up, Brightborn controlling this TABOO Treasure to come to a stop.
BZZT!

They were actually in a tumultuous region within the Boundary Between Realities, baleful storms of Aether constantly tearing apart and reforming space as the tendrils of essence even ripped space to a white blankness!

It was an utterly dangerous location to be in as even Noah's eyes lit up when gazing at the surroundings, these tendrils of Aether that could each rival an attack from A Legend's Visage actually being a mere natural phenomenon.

The figure of Purple Endeavor TABOO Relic released a profound glow of power as it wondrously pulsed aside the storms of baleful aether that some Ninth Firmament existences on this vessel stared at with hardened expressions.
They arrived in such a place as Brightborn spoke out freely while gazing at the depths of this unique Domain Space.
"It is time."
OOOM!

His words reached to the depths of this Unstable Aether Domain that had snaking tendrils of aether, something actually reacting and beginning to float out towards the ship as a shockingly animalistic aura of a deadly beast pervaded outwards!
It shockingly seemed to rival an aura of a beginner LEGEND even though it wasn't, the waves of power being powerful and concentrated but still in the Firmaments of Ascendancy!
BZZZT!
With a flash of light and speed other beings couldn't even capture, a figure instantly moved from the Aether storms to appear aboard the Purple Endeavor in front of Brightborn.

Glorious in power, it was a shocking beast in human form as one could see a devilishly handsome man clad in a crackling purple armor appear- his eyes filled with age and vicissitude as he looked to be in his golden age of 40s!

But this existence had inevitably lived for many billions of years as above his head, one could shockingly see a purple ecriture of <EMPEROR> circling a solidified crown and releasing pulses of authoritative light that inadvertently caused the 5 Adjudicator Legions in the back of the Purple Endeavor to nearly kneel.
His expression was wild and ferocious as he stared at Brightborn without an ounce of respect, nodding to him as if he was a peer as his voice was filled with weight and power as he nodded.
"As promised."
WAA!
One of the 'Guests' that Brightborn had invited to enter the Unexplored Grotto Sanctum appeared as such beings were existences that held shocking identities.

They weren't bothered by power and identities as they were geniuses from the past Age- existences that had chosen to repress their Realm and remain in the Cosmic Filament Realm since the last Age as they never broke through!

They had been patiently waiting and forging their foundations as when entering a new Age, they exceeded their Limits and obtained increased authority that their peers who had become LEGENDS would have a hard time obtaining.

This was why Brightborn's solidified crown was blank and barely beginning to form an Ecriture, while this being who seemed like a beast born of Aether shockingly had the word <EMPEROR> rotating gloriously on his solidified crown.

He was a monstrous genius from the Olden Era that had repressed himself until now, ready to explode with a shocking foundation and power as a mere wave of his hands seemed capable of releasing arcs of Aether that were comparable to the might of a LEGEND!
His gaze was apathetic as he walked past Brightborn and into the Purple Endeavor, his eyes landing on everyone here as they screamed of arrogance and power- and he could truly back up such a gaze!

He gazed at everyone as if they were mere children before his eyes, about to flash towards the descending purple gold stairs to isolate himself in the lower decks until this vessel arrived at the Unexplored Grotto Sanctum when his eyes happened to pass over the visage of none other than Adjudicator Katelyn.
HOOONG!
Lustrous light bloomed from his eyes as a trace of shock appeared, which then turned into greed and excitement as this shocking being turned into a streak of light towards her in an instant!

chapters.title: Chapter 1781
paragraphs: Chapter 1781 Old Monsters From the Past Age! lll

A shocking development bloomed as faster than what the eyes of even the 5 Legions of Adjudicator Legions could follow, the visage of this newly joining being flashed towards Katelyn the moment his eyes landed on her- his gaze filled with greed and excitement as if he was looking at an insatiable meal!

His body pulsed with illusory golden Halos of Ascendancy and even a shimmering black halo as he used their multiplicative authority passively, arcs of Aether chains that caused the surrounding space to tremble coiling in his arms as they would seemingly act like chains to capture the silver white haired beauty aboard the Purple Endeavor.

Most beings couldn't react to the shocking speed of this terrifying existence as it was too abrupt, where even though Brightborn saw his movements, he could only develop an angered expression as this being already came inches away from Katelyn!

Those in the surroundings couldn't even react, but Noah's visage was watching everything as if it was playing out in slow motion before his eyes as waves of destiny swirled around him...actually telling him that he had no need to even make a move as an astounding scene played out.
Towards this terrifying existence that Brightborn had invited suddenly rushing towards her- Katelyn's eyes held no trace of shock or surprise.
Her calm smile was only wiped away as her glazed mirror like eyes faced this being with terrifying apathy!
BZZZT!

Her hands didn't even move as around her body, the silent authority of a black Ascendancy Halo flashed as the few inches difference between her and the coiling arcs of Aether from the hands of this monstrous genius from the Olden...an indestructible mirror bloomed.
BOOOM!

The tendrils of aether smashed onto it as no force was directed outwards, seemingly absorbed entirely by the pristine mirror as an instant later- it shot everything out with even more ferocity against the attacking being as his figure was instantly flung away from the Purple Endeavor and onto the storms of Aether outside the TABOO Vessel!
WAA!
"XIAN!"

Only now did the thundering voice of Brightborn arrive as he looked utterly furious, staring towards the arcs of Aether storms where the monstrous being he called Xian had stopped and was still only focused on Katelyn with his eyes still releasing vibrant rays of excitement.
"You..." His voice was deep and heavy as he looked like an Emperor bathed in flourishing Aether, a gaze of yearning clearly prevalent when he gazed at his target
"....you've got such a thing around you and you haven't eaten it up yet?!"
"XIAN!"
BOOM!
Brightborn became utterly furious at these words as his aura rose.
"We made a contract...behave!"
HOOONG!
The billowing might of a LEGEND gushed down as the eyes of Xian continued to release vibrant light while gazing at Katelyn as if she was a prized food he had to claim!
The might of a LEGEND wrapped around him entirely as he didn't move, Brightborn moving to utterly isolate this being as he sent a mental message while still keeping a furious face.
'I didn't think you would be able to see anything about her...but keep your fucking calm if you want to keep our bargain.'

The eyes of the LEGEND flashed as aboard the Purple Endeavor, the 5 Adjudicator Legions had mobilized and come to surround Katelyn and the others as they looked dangerously towards the man bathed in Aether.
Brightborn's angry face calmly settled after his words caused Xian to not make any more moves, turning towards Katelyn as he sighed apologetically.
"I apologize for this, Katelyn. This is an old contact that I have an agreement with for the Unexplored Grotto Sanctum, I didn't think he would act this way."
A genuine LEGEND shockingly spoke out words of apology on behalf of the existence known as Xian.
Katelyn looked at this with sharp eyes that held a trace of anger, gazing towards the defiant Xian surrounded by arcs of Aether as she spoke lightly.
"He cannot keep traveling with us."

Her words were filled with a commanding might as the hearts of the Ninth Firmament Adjudicators trembled beside her, yet Brightborn's face was unphased as he only became calm and moved his hands- a maddening silver light moving to cover the figure of Xian and then shooting it down the purple gold stairway leading to the lower decks of the Purple Endeavor as he spoke in a tone that wouldn't be defied!

"I'll make sure he remains in the lowest deck as we cannot lose any of our forces before even entering the Unexplored Grotto Sanctum...and I'll make sure that something like this doesn't happen again."

The LEGEND spoke in an undeniable tone as when Katelyn heard these words and saw his actions of placing this being that had just attacked her and insultingly talked about her like an object into the depths of the vessel they were on...a light of disappointment flashed in her eyes.

The visage of Brightborn returned to the helm of the Purple Endeavor that began to move again, this incident being wiped like this as those aboard the vessel looked at each other with complex emotions before scattering to their old positions!

The harmonious conversations didn't continue as with her smile fading, Katelyn gazed towards Brightborn that had gone back to operate the Vessel in another direction as she shook her head and walked towards the purple gold stairway, going into the pristine deck below as she entered one of the unique spatial rooms and closed the Runic engraved door behind her!
She didn't seem to fear the contained existence in the lowest deck at all as even when he moved in surprise, she had rebuffed him effortlessly.
But when she left, Noah breathed out as this event told him many things- and Lavalliere saw even more!

A small incident aboard the TABOO Vessel that would soon make its way into the Unexplored Grotto Sanctum occurred as it provided abundant information on many things, and all of this was caused by a single 'Guest' that Brightborn had picked up.

There would be more than one of such Guests as it wasn't just Brightborn doing this- but all of the LEGENDS of the respective Pure-Blooded Cardinal Royal Bloodlines tasked with bringing geniuses of their Domains towards the Unexplored Grotto Sanctum and even lone Primordial LEGENDS who wanted to send their own powerful tools into this Sanctum to obtain this were doing the same!

Just like how Brightborn had approached Genevieve and Noah and told them to bring him back Grotto Nacres and other treasures in exchange for a myriad of things- such contracts and agreements were being formed between many LEGENDS and genius existences in the Firmaments of Ascendancy as many beings could feel that boundless fortune was contained in this domain of space that even LEGENDS weren't allowed in.
The weaving of fate and destiny moved intricately as many beings moved, Noah finishing his preparations in the Cosmic Holy Land as he was approaching a major undeniable milestone soon!

chapters.title: Chapter 1782
paragraphs: Chapter 1782 Tenth Cycle!
In the expanded Cosmic Holy Land.

Flourishing stellar Infinite Reality Passages amounting to 37 pulsed with waves of boundless essence onto Noah's body, the constant burning of his Origin through Sanguine Adequation paving the way forward as another Cycle of the Infinite Dream Physique neared its completion!
Multiple Clones were working tirelessly to suck in Dream Essence as all of it surged into Noah's body, his visage lighting up with a silvery white light once more as he spoke out lightly.
"A Touch of Fate."

Noah's body shone with a wondrous gold light as he pulled upon 90% of all the fate within his body to try and affect the path of an event similar to when he cast <A Touch of Fortune> and succeeded in turning the finishing of one Cycle into two!
WAA!
The targeted event came to fruition.
<The Seventh Cycle of the Infinite Dream Physique has been completed.>
BZZZT!
Waves of golden fate permeated throughout as Noah's stellar figure became enshrined in gold throughout!
<The pull of Fate has surged into the completion of a Cycle!>
The waves of golden fate shone brightly as Noah looked on expectantly, his Tyrannical gaze shifting in the last moment as he actually felt fate...fizzling out.
<The Fate of the targeted event could not be changed.>
WAA!
The prompt of the cycle succeeding again didn't come as unlike A Touch of Fortune that flourished and succeeded, <A Touch of Fate> did not!

<More Runic Ecritures of DREAM begin to surround you as the completion of the Seventh Cycle Increases your Maximum Reserves of Dream Essence to 3,000,000. The current DREAM Ecritures allow for the passive daily generation of 1,500,000 Units of Dream Essence.>
<The Maximum Number of Reality Passages your body can hold has been raised to 400.>
Only a single cycle was completed as Noah looked at this with luminous stellar eyes, Lavalliere's voice entering his mind soon after.

<Even with all the control and overabundance of Fate, Destiny, Fortune, and Karma- one can at times still fail to change a path. <The Infinite Dream Physique has begun its evolution.>
BOOOM!
Shocking bursts of Dream Essence gushed into Noah's body endlessly.

It was said that a change would occur when the Infinite Dream Physique reached the 10th Cycle!
That stellar change bloomed now in a shocking fashion as Noah had yet another fundamental change beginning to bloom within his body.

It was as if something Natural that was already there but he just didn't know could finally be felt by him!
It was the change and elevation of the Infinite Dream Physique into a Mythical Natural Born Physique.
<The Infinite Dream Physique is being transformed into the Mythical Natural Born Infinite Dream Physique!>
HUUM!

His clone in the Dream Dimension trembled as it merely acted like a conduit at this moment, surging waves of Dream Essence coursing through it and nearly shredding apart its Origin as it wasn't enough!
And this was the time that a disastrous prompt rose before Noah's eyes.
<Your Reserves of Dream Essence are multiplied by 100 times.>
HOOOONG!
A booming sound of a horn resonated out as Noah's stellar visage became illuminated by a silver gold sandy light!
The Cosmic Holy Land that was already flourishing with vibrant Essence erupted out to become pervaded with the Dream Essence of a Dimension as Noah's body swirled with intense fervor.
Boundless Dream Essence pervaded throughout as this wasn't all.
...DING!
Soon enough...the Infinite Reality Passages above Noah began to resonate as they provided all sources of essence Noah had access to.

With the advent of the Mythical Natural Born Infinite Dream Physique, he gained ridiculous expanded access to Dream Essence as the rivers of stellar essence coming from the Infinite Reality Passages surged with golden sandy Dimensional Dream Essence as it bathed Noah's figure gloriously.
Like a king being showered with glory.
Like an Emperor undergoing a transformation in an even more fantastical form!
Just one of the perks of the advent of the Infinite Dream Physique was actually multiplying the Dream Essence Reserves Noah had by 100.
The prompts that Noah had glazed over from the 10th Cycle being completed repeated in Noah's mind.

<More Runic Ecritures of DREAM begin to surround you as the completion of the Tenth Cycle Increases your Maximum Reserves of Dream Essence to 5,000,000. The current DREAM Ecritures allow for the passive daily generation of 2,500,000 Units of Dream Essence.>
<The Maximum Number of Reality Passages your body can hold has been raised to 490.>
These were the two prompts not shown before as their values were what the 100 multiplier affected.
It meant...
<Your Maximum Reserves of Dream Essence have been elevated to 500,000,000.>
<Your passive daily generation of Dream Essence is 250,000,000 Units.>
This alone was utterly ridiculous.
One must realize...this was a pristine Dimensional Essence!

Just the little that another had a few days ago had already allowed for many things, where he even had to be in the Dream Dimension to fully cultivate his Cycles of the now Mythical Natural Born Infinite Dream Physique.
But with such large reserves of Dream Essence in his body...he wouldn't even need to be supplied by the Dream Dimension in order to elevate his Cycles.
That was how profound that change was!
And this was just the first boon.

<Due to achieving the 10th Cycle and unlocking the Mythical Natural Born Infinite Dream Physique, all cultivated Physiques are drawing upon the Infinite Dream Physique Refinement as they seek to complete another round of refinement!>
WAA!
A fantastical boon!
And also...
"Fuck."
OOOM!

It was also something that shockingly caused a problem at this moment as Noah's body was already nearing the Limit after all the Physiques he had refined on top of the 10 Cycles of the Mythical Natural Born Infinite Dream Physique.

The Burgeoning Limit Breaking Extreme Physique, the Chassis, Relegator, Arcadian, Mana...all of the Physiques Noah had cultivated clicked as if a lock was elevated with them- exceeding their Limits and beginning to undergo another round of refinement purely utilizing the requirements of the refinement of the Mythical Natural Born Infinite Dream Physique!
It instantly caused Noah to shift the target of Sanguine Adequation to only his soul as what he tried to burn now was the progression of his Body.

This was because the moment these Physiques began their automatic refinement and raised the foundation of his body even higher, the ultimate limit of his Body was reached as everything nearly lulled- including the advancement of the Mythical Natural Born Infinite Dream Physique!
BZZZT!

So now, Noah furiously burned the Aspect of Existence that was the Body as his Physiques were all surging with refinement, the strength brought forth going towards to now elevate the Soul that was the hardest to raise towards the peak.
It meant that very soon, Noah would have all three Aspects of Existence raised to the highest possible limits he could bring them to before he stepped into the Unexplored Grotto Sanctum!
<A Natural Born Physique has flourished at your core.>

The profound changes of the elevation into the Mythical Natural Born Infinite Dream Physique began to blaze in Noah's mind at this time as he felt a new concept brand itself onto his very Aspects of Existence.
This caused some changes that even he wasn't entirely familiar with.
<The authority of the Unnamed Kainos Emperor has undergone an unknown change.>
WAA!
His radiant crown flashed amidst the raging splendorous white gold essence surging around him as the ecritures of <ETHEREAL EMPE> gained a distinct sandy golden glow that was hard to miss.
Noah's will gazed at this unique phenomenon as even the prompt for it stated that the change was unknown!

chapters.title: Chapter 1784
paragraphs: Chapter 1784 A Mythical Natural Born Physique! ll
A change to his authority had occurred as while Noah was surrounded by surging essence and cracks of another Dimension entirely, he couldn't help but pay attention to this!

Even while Sanguine Adequation was working on overdrive to redirect the strength of the body to the Soul and slow down the raging elevation of all of Noah's physiques so that he didn't reach the limit of his body before finishing the full advancement of the newly born Physique..Noah couldn't help but gaze at his crown that showed off his authority!
The unknown change that had occurred dealt with too many unknowns as he couldn't help but ask the existence that seemed to know a great deal.
"What changes occur to the authority when one gains something linked to a Dimension?"
WAA!
Yes.
The change stemmed from the Mythical Natural Born Infinite Dream Physique.
But even as Noah asked, Lavalliere remained silent as she uttered no words!
This was because this involved too many secrets.
Just what was the authority of Emperors that existences were building up in this Age? How did it relate to the Infinite Realities, and how did it relate to the current Realities?

Did it have anything to do with the vast Dimensions like the Mirror and Dream Dimensions that seemed to have their own unknown forces and Hegemonies? And how did all of this fit into Lavalliere calling the vast Realities Barren Lands?!

The biggest question of all was the seat of the True Emperor that OPPENHEIMER had attained in the last Age and used its authority to do something utterly shocking. What exactly was this and what secrets did it hold...
These questions and many swirled in Noah's mind as he had no answers, only gazing at his spinning crown and ecritures silently as boundless essence still surged around him.
Meanwhile, the description of the Mythical Natural Born Infinite Dream Physique slowly became clear in his mind as Noah condensed its many prompts into a singular definition.

[<Mythical Natural Born Dream Physique>:: The elevation of the Infinite Dream Physique born from Absolute Dream Authority. Even though you weren't born with it, you have undergone a successful budding of this physique and have been recognized by the Dream Dimension. A unique Dream Physique that fundamentally changes a core of your being is born as you are granted the capability to convert your True Reality Damage and Defense Values to True Dimensional Dream Damage and Defense Values. Different to True Reality Damage Values, True Dimensional Dream Damage Values impose the Reality altering debuff effects of <Endless Dream>, causing the abilities of the target to gradually enter the dwelling of dreams and become deactivated. If one suffers enough True Dimensional Dream Damage, their Ascendancy Halos, Reality Passages, and other forms of Authority will gradually also become deactivated and unusable as at the end of it all- even their very Aspects of Existence shall forever fall into an Endless Dream...]
Barely a half of the description of the Mythical Natural Born Infinite Dream Physique came down as its contents were already terror inducing for any being unlucky enough to be Noah's enemy!

One of the many boons of the Mythical Natural Born Infinite Dream Physique was that Noah could convert his damage and Defenses into Dimensional Damage and Defence Values. But...what did this exactly mean?
How much more of his True Reality Damage Values could get through to other existences, and how much stronger were his defenses?!

This wasn't listed in the details as what was listed was the shocking perk of the True Dimensional Dream Damage being capable of making everything about the enemy fall into the land of dreams. Their concepts, Halos, Reality Passages, and even their Aspects of Existence! Such a thought alone was terrifying as apart from Noah being able to suppress others with his Infinite Reality Passages- he could now do even deadlier oppression so long as he began to deal damage to them.
His eyes hungrily searched for the remaining portion of the details of this Mythical Natural Born Infinite Dream Physique!

[...The Mythical Natural Born Dream Physique also grants an unnatural amount of Dream Essence Reserves through the ability <Dreamling>, a passive ability that also allows you to move across the boundaries of the Dream Dimension unhindered among other things. The <Dimensional Dream Tamer> ability is also granted as it allows you to tame a small number of existences bound to the Dream Dimension so long as you can defeat them. Other features and an elevation of the features of the Mythical Natural Born Infinite Dream Physique will be unlocked when another 20 new Cycles Pass...>]
"Beautiful..."
Noah's eyes shone with dazzling light as his surroundings began to calm.

His Infinite Reality Passages gushed with a myriad of essences as the Dimensional Dream Essence became among those at the very forefront, Noah's body becoming bathed in resplendent stellar multicolored light and drizzles of sandy gold as he seemed like a celestial creature floating in the skies!

Yet his eyes released luminous lights of excitement at the sheer details of the Mythical Natural Born Infinite Dream Physique that granted <Dreamling> and <Dimensional Dream Tamer> as some more of its features- with more waiting for Noah to unlock as he increased his cycles in this Physique.
The number of cycles was an additional 20 as even though it wasn't hard for Noah to reach this number, it would be impossible for the foreseeable future!
That is...unless he breaks the shackles of the Firmament of Ascendancy and forms his Reality.

This was because his Body neared completion as he had to burn it at this moment as all his Physiques were automatically being raised due to the completion of the 10th Cycle, with his shackles of the Seventh Firmament that he had released when he formed his passages taking his Ascendancy Value past the 999 million of the Eighth Firmament of Ascendancy as he reached the Ascendancy Value exceeded the 1 Billion that marked the beginning of the Ninth Firmament of Ascendancy and reach 9.9 Billion of the peak Ninth Firmament of Ascendancy at this point in time!

An Ascendancy Value that didn't mean much for the level of strength of Limit Breakers and other genius existences- a Value that was incomparably far from Noah just weeks ago...but he had achieved it so seamlessly at this moment.

He had attained this and much more as at this moment, he couldn't help but gaze at his Aspects of Existence that were painted with a golden sandy hue that represented the Mythical Natural Born Infinite Dream Physique!
<Author Note>

The peak of the Seventh Firmament has been revised to be 99 Million Ascendancy Values. 100 Million signifies entrance into the Eighth Firmament of Ascendancy, with the peak being 999 Million. 1 Billion signifies entrance into the Ninth Firmament of Ascendancy, with the peak being 9.9 Billion.

These questions and many swirled in Noah's mind as he had no answers, only gazing at his spinning crown and ecritures silently as boundless essence still surged around him.
Meanwhile, the description of the Mythical Natural Born Infinite Dream Physique slowly became clear in his mind as Noah condensed its many prompts into a singular definition.
[<Mythical Natural Born Dream Physique>:: The elevation of the Infinite Dream Physique born from Absolute Dream Authority.
Even though you weren't born with it, you have undergone a successful budding of this physique and have been recognized by the Dream Dimension.

A unique Dream Physique that fundamentally changes a core of your being is born as you are granted the capability to convert your True Reality Damage and Defense Values to True Dimensional Dream Damage and Defense Values.

Different to True Reality Damage Values, True Dimensional Dream Damage Values impose the Reality altering debuff effects of <Endless Dream>, causing the abilities of the target to gradually enter the dwelling of dreams and become deactivated.

If one suffers enough True Dimensional Dream Damage, their Ascendancy Halos, Reality Passages, and other forms of Authority will gradually also become deactivated and unusable as at the end of it all- even their very Aspects of Existence shall forever fall into an Endless Dream...]
Barely a half of the description of the Mythical Natural Born Infinite Dream Physique came down as its contents were already terror inducing for any being unlucky enough to be Noah's enemy!
One of the many boons of the Mythical Natural Born Infinite Dream Physique was that Noah could convert his damage and Defenses into Dimensional Damage and Defence Values.
But...what did this exactly mean?
How much more of his True Reality Damage Values could get through to other existences, and how much stronger were his defenses?!
This wasn't listed in the details as what was listed was the shocking perk of the True Dimensional Dream Damage being capable of making everything about the enemy fall into the land of dreams.
Their concepts, Halos, Reality Passages, and even their Aspects of Existence!

Such a thought alone was terrifying as apart from Noah being able to suppress others with his Infinite Reality Passages- he could now do even deadlier oppression so long as he began to deal damage to them.
His eyes hungrily searched for the remaining portion of the details of this Mythical Natural Born Infinite Dream Physique!

[...The Mythical Natural Born Dream Physique also grants an unnatural amount of Dream Essence Reserves through the ability <Dreamling>, a passive ability that also allows you to move across the boundaries of the Dream Dimension unhindered among other things.
The <Dimensional Dream Tamer> ability is also granted as it allows you to tame a small number of existences bound to the Dream Dimension so long as you can defeat them.
Other features and an elevation of the features of the Mythical Natural Born Infinite Dream Physique will be unlocked when another 20 new Cycles Pass...>]
"Beautiful..."
Noah's eyes shone with dazzling light as his surroundings began to calm.

His Infinite Reality Passages gushed with a myriad of essences as the Dimensional Dream Essence became among those at the very forefront, Noah's body becoming bathed in resplendent stellar multicolored light and drizzles of sandy gold as he seemed like a celestial creature floating in the skies!

Yet his eyes released luminous lights of excitement at the sheer details of the Mythical Natural Born Infinite Dream Physique that granted <Dreamling> and <Dimensional Dream Tamer> as some more of its features- with more waiting for Noah to unlock as he increased his cycles in this Physique.
The number of cycles was an additional 20 as even though it wasn't hard for Noah to reach this number, it would be impossible for the foreseeable future!
That is...unless he breaks the shackles of the Firmament of Ascendancy and forms his Reality.

This was because his Body neared completion as he had to burn it at this moment as all his Physiques were automatically being raised due to the completion of the 10th Cycle, with his shackles of the Seventh Firmament that he had released when he formed his passages taking his Ascendancy Value past the 999 million of the Eighth Firmament of Ascendancy as he reached the Ascendancy Value exceeded the 1 Billion that marked the beginning of the Ninth Firmament of Ascendancy and reach 9.9 Billion of the peak Ninth Firmament of Ascendancy at this point in time!

An Ascendancy Value that didn't mean much for the level of strength of Limit Breakers and other genius existences- a Value that was incomparably far from Noah just weeks ago...but he had achieved it so seamlessly at this moment.

He had attained this and much more as at this moment, he couldn't help but gaze at his Aspects of Existence that were painted with a golden sandy hue that represented the Mythical Natural Born Infinite Dream Physique!
<Author Note>
The peak of the Seventh Firmament has been revised to be 99 Million Ascendancy Values.
100 Million signifies entrance into the Eighth Firmament of Ascendancy, with the peak being 999 Million.
1 Billion signifies entrance into the Ninth Firmament of Ascendancy, with the peak being 9.9 Billion.

paragraphs: Chapter 1785 A Mythical Natural Born Physique! lll
In the Purple Endeavor streaking across space.

The eyes of Noah's True Sanguine Clone that was acting as Alexander flashed with shocking radiance right before his main body had undergone the change and attained the Mythical Natural Born Infinite Dream Physique!

The brought about change affected all of the Clones as it was rather drastic, where Noah's destiny told him he had to act fast to make sure that his clone wasn't seen through even under the veil of LETHE!

The eruption of Essence was simply too destructive as his Body attained shocking levels of strength, his clone instantly sitting down in a meditative position aboard the vast deck of the Purple Endeavor where he was surrounded by Legions of Primordial Adjudicators behind him shimmering with Valor and power, and the visage of Genevieve and Brightborn ahead of him as more monstrous existences were hidden bow this TABOO Vessel.
BZZZT!

To hide the undeniable Essence that was about to erupt from his clone, Noah had to either cut off the connection with this clone and disable it entirely- this bringing its death...or he could mask the eruption of essence of his Body attaining a Dimensional Physique with surges of Essence of Reality!
The Essence that interwove around the Natural Laws of Reality to make up the very Reality itself.
This was the only thing Noah had in his arsenal that he felt could mask the eruption of Dream Essence as with the aid of LETHE...
BOOM!

His meditating body was seen to erupt with a storm of Essence of Reality that pushed those nearby away, the eyes of Brightborn and Genevieve locking onto him instantly as others moved back in alarm and shock!

The genius Royal Humans aboard this vessel looked at the overpowering bursts of strength the visage of this being released as his very skin had coiling arcs of unidentifiable light that far surpassed anything in the Firmaments of Ascendancy!
"Is he actually close to...exceeding the Limits of the Body and becoming a Limit Breaker?"
A small voice of a nearby Adjudicator Commander that was under Katelyn spoke out in disbelief.

This was because they knew the genius follower of Genevieve appeared to have forged three Physiques successfully, being extremely strong with his body as he had even bathed in the Sacred Blood Sea to nearly attain a Bloodline onto True Royalty of the Royal Humans from the Pure Reality held!
"Haha, good! If he succeeds, you would have a truly strong body practitioner by your side, Little Gen!"
Brightborn's strong voice was jovial as this being was happier that those he had agreements with were getting more powerful- only thinking of the possible boons he would be getting in the end.
Meanwhile, the eyes of Genevieve hid their hidden somberness as in her eyes- the enemy she had resolved to devour the talent of only became more difficult for her to handle.
These were the destinies of Chosen Emperors.
They would somehow be exceeding their Limits out of nowhere as one might be considered crazy to ever target them!
But Genevieve remained steadfast in her aims as she knew of one particular being that had succeeded.
OPPENHEIMER!
He had hunted Chosen Emperors and butchered them like chickens on his path to becoming a True Emperor.
So Genevieve raised her head high as she held a level of confidence due to the number of TABOO Edicts and a Physique she had pulled from her old Body and Origin in the Royal Treasury!
'Surely, I can handle a single Chosen Emperor that hasn't even become a LEGEND...'

Her eyes shone luminously with such thoughts as on the deck below, the figure of Katelyn that was isolated from everything else in a unique spatially enclosed room opened her glazed silver eyes at this moment to lock onto Noah who others saw to be undergoing a breakthrough with his Body.

Her Mirror like eyes bypassed the vibrant layers of multicolored Essence of Reality that Noah was utilizing with LETHE to fool the eyes of others as she saw a trace of Dimensional Essence, her eyes becoming filled with sharp radiance as more curiosity arose from this being she had secretly observed before!

The Purple Endeavor continued on as Brightborn had to collect more genius existences he had made deals with before making way towards the Unexplored Grotto Sanctum, the identity of the Royal Human known as Alexander becoming elevated in the eyes of many as he became an existence that might very soon exceed the limits of the Body under their eyes!
With his True Sanguine Clone covered, Noah's main body retained most of its will as he took a closer look at his shimmering body as the surging essences around him calmed down every so little.
BZZT!

Above him, the 49th Infinite Reality Passage formed as it rained down glorious rivers of essence, Noah having a difficult expression on his body as when he felt the robust strength brought about by the Mythical Natural Born Infinite Dream Physique, he knew that none of the many Physiques that had gained another chance to be refined would be able to finish their refinements unless he forged his Reality!

His body had truly reached its utmost Limitations as he could go no further without undergoing resonance of his Three Aspects of Existence, where even now as he burned the Body with Sanguine Adequation to raise the soul, it would raise back towards the unbreakable ceiling soon after.
Seeing this situation, Noah sighed as Lavalliere's voice echoed out.
<I think you've prepared more than enough, no? Your soul's just about to be full as well, with the only other possibilities and opportunities lying in the hands of fate and destiny.>
He had prepared enough.
This was what every part of his cells told him as Noah nodded, bringing his hands up as he saw the boundless strength within them that held shocking meaning.
When one truly thought about it, his Body alone through its many Physiques had base boosts above 2,850+ in True Reality Damage Values!
Again, one had to understand what this truly signified! A wave of Noah's hand or a pinch of his fingers...was now equivalent to the destruction of hundreds of Realities.
This was before any multiplicative effects through Authorities like Halos and True Forms as when those were included, his damage went towards the equivalent destruction of millions of Realities!
When Noah looked at all of this and the many more things to come, he could only repeat Lavalliere's words while nodding.
"I've prepared enough..."
WAA!
